name: True Raymarched Text Reveal
definition: A raymarching technique that renders text by converting DOM glyphs into a 3D Signed Distance Field (SDF), marching rays through it, and revealing it with smooth-min metaballs and SDF-gradient lighting.
summary: True Raymarched Text Reveal renders text by marching rays through a 3D extruded SDF, distinguishing itself from 2D blur techniques by enabling complex lighting and metaball interactions.
